Who we are

Meet your hosts

Analytics, ML and AI agents

Daniel Večeřa

Builds the recommendation engine behind Oneplay and develops the agentic system behind Agentic Analytics. Earlier: energy-market analytics at VARO Energy and revenue analytics at Groupon. Connects hands-on modelling and software with the decisions a business needs to make.

Delivery and measurement

Josef Vodička

Owns product measurement for Oneplay and leads delivery across the data & BI team behind it. Takes a metric end to end, from the first conversation about what to measure to the decision it drives. Came up through engineering, which is why he distrusts any number he can’t trace.

Business and commercial

Ivan Vodička

25 years as CEO and in top roles at Netbrokers, Mall Group, Alpine Pro, Generali Česká pojišťovna and Nutricia/Danone. Focused on automation, digital customer experience and financial management, and holds the business side of the definitions, where the disagreements live.
